title: Appraisal Documentation Standards, Larkspur Valuables Floater
content:
On the Larkspur Valuables Floater, three appraisal figures are set by tier: the scheduled value above which a written appraisal or bill of sale is required, the oldest appraisal accepted when an item is scheduled, and the cycle after which items above the appraisal threshold must be re-appraised at renewal.

| Tier | Written appraisal or bill of sale required above (USD) | Oldest appraisal accepted at scheduling (years) | Re-appraisal cycle at renewal (years) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Valuables Floater Classic | 2500 | 3 | 5 |
| Valuables Floater Select | 2500 | 3 | 5 |
| Valuables Floater Preferred | 5000 | 5 | 5 |
| Valuables Floater Prestige | 5000 | 5 | 5 |
| Valuables Floater Collector | 10000 | 5 | 7 |
| Valuables Floater Private Client | 10000 | 5 | 7 |

## Notes on the figures

- **Threshold.** The requirement applies to a scheduled value *above* the figure: on the Valuables Floater Classic an item valued at exactly 2500 USD is not above the threshold, and an item valued at 2600 USD is.
- **Oldest appraisal accepted.** The figure is the age, in years, of the oldest written appraisal or bill of sale accepted when an item valued above the threshold is scheduled.
- **Re-appraisal cycle.** The figure is the number of years after which items above the appraisal threshold must be re-appraised at renewal.

## Tier comparison (hypothetical item)

A hypothetical watch valued at 7000 USD, with an appraisal dated four years and one month before the scheduling date:

| Tier | Above threshold? | Appraisal age acceptable at scheduling? |
|---|---|---|
| Classic or Select | yes (above 2500) | no (older than 3 years) |
| Preferred or Prestige | yes (above 5000) | yes (within 5 years) |
| Collector or Private Client | no (not above 10000) | not in question, since no written appraisal is required at this value |
